items.alt: Two activists behind the bars of a locked protest gate look toward a large padlock as Rahul Gandhi gestures from outside; five calendar sheets hang along the bars.
An empty executive conference room sits under a security camera while a tiny recording device peeks from the cardboard core of a toilet-paper roll beside the wall-mounted screen.
A new square home display with a glowing voice waveform and family silhouettes arrives with a suitcase as older smart speakers lounge around a living room.
S Jaishankar and Marco Rubio push a paper airplane marked by Indian and US flags down a runway lined with oil barrels and scattered documents.
A bull slides down a stock-chart slope slick with spilled crude oil as a rupee coin-shaped balloon rises over a city and bank buildings.
A furious footballer in a red kit points toward suited executives hiding behind an empty shopping cart above a pitch where two balls rest in a striped net.
